integrity: Two independent complete standalone finite enumerators with exhaustive pairwise, shortest-path and label-permutation checks; complete decoded artifacts supplied with byte lengths and hashes.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite result only for PG(3,2), replacing entire spreads. Earlier 1970 report has only month-level publication evidence; The 2000 Soicher date is a retrospective classification checkpoint. Exact public source date 2015-04-13 comes from the original Betten manuscript upload, not a historical first-discovery claim. 1995 Jeurissen full text inaccessible, potential prior-equivalence risk. Independent scholarly audit not performed.
title: The minimum three-spread trade graph of the 240 projective-space packings
